scope: beta-only non-physical simulator; never an ICAO production bureau
authentication: Existing GRPC_SERVICE_TOKEN bearer token; no new passport token file
durability: PostgreSQL organization_id plus source_job_id idempotency; a changed document identity digest returns 409, while a retry with a different SOD signature or public DSC certificate returns the original bureau job ID
document_type_replay_rule: The frozen batch wire omits document_type. Single and batch submissions for the same tenant and content share one bureau job; the first explicit TD1/TD2/TD3 type is retained, and a different later explicit type returns 409. Legacy rows without the type-neutral digest fail closed on replay.
retry_semantics: The first accepted document identity is authoritative. SOD and DSC are validated as present on every submission but excluded from the identity digest because re-signing may change them. A retry does not reset bureau status or create another job.
managed_ceremony_order: Issue and verify the selected organization CSCA and DSC before generating the passport SOD or submitting the native passport job; compare the immutable simulator receipt to that preselected DSC and the generated/submitted SOD for the same tenant, source job and bureau job

first_accepted_material_receipt.source: Hash the decoded SOD DER, parsed DSC DER and exact UTF-8 DSC PEM wire value on the first accepted single or batch submission; store only their digests in the private simulator row
first_accepted_material_receipt.compatibility: Keep the frozen nonempty-field acceptance rule: malformed synthetic SOD or certificate values may be accepted but have null canonical DER digests and cannot satisfy beta evidence
first_accepted_material_receipt.retry: The first accepted digests are immutable when the same document is replayed with another signature or certificate; legacy rows without digests cannot qualify
first_accepted_material_receipt.protected_read: Read only inside the protected beta host using all three binding fields; do not add a public receipt route or upload raw material or these unkeyed digests
first_accepted_material_receipt.public_evidence: Publish only verified comparison outcomes and keyed source-job/bureau-job commitments after the protected read

callback.signature: KMS-held passport-bureau-callback HMAC via internal signing-keys gateway
